subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should session-catalog providers permanently expose an optional core new-session target as `createSession: { model }`, with the gateway and Control UI treating that metadata as authoritative?
rationale: The implementation is additive and appears coherent, but it expands public plugin SDK and gateway protocol surfaces; automated tests cannot determine whether this narrow model-only shape is the intended long-term API.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Accept the optional model-only capability as the provider-owned seam and proceed after final-head proof and CI complete.

options.title: Generalize catalog actions first
options.body: Pause landing and define a broader typed catalog action contract if more creation parameters or actions are expected soon.

options.title: Keep creation owner-private
options.body: Remove the public capability and use a provider-specific command or integration rather than extending the core catalog contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional model-only capability as the provider-owned seam and proceed after final-head proof and CI complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This member currently owns the implementation and its cross-boundary design, making them the best available person to coordinate the required contract decision.
